recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
chmod +x gradlew
DEX_FILE=app/build/intermediates/dex/release/minifyReleaseWithR8/classes.dex
DEX_SHA1=95a05dfa8ffcaa10d5e9f562e8f854b7c1049970
for _ in {1..10}; do
./gradlew clean assembleRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
test -f "$DEX_FILE"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$DEX_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$DEX_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
